user.title: Radar Presence
user.description: Sets up your home. Radars are then added as parts of it: the first one right away, more with Add radar on the integration page. Rooms, spots and doorways are drawn in the Presence panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Radar Presence is already set up. Add radars from its integration page.

user.title: Pick a radar sensor
user.description: Devices that expose per-target X/Y coordinate sensors (Everything Presence Lite/Pro, Screek 2A, other LD2450 firmwares). Area, floor and the number of targets each radar sees right now are shown to tell them apart (walk in front of one and reopen to check). The room gets presence right away; spots, doorways and ignore areas are drawn afterwards in the Presence panel.

import_legacy.title: Import existing polygons
import_legacy.description: Found {count} polygon helper(s) (input_text.…_zone_polygon_N) for this sensor. Import them as rooms? The helpers are not changed or removed.

abort.no_devices: No unconfigured radar sensors with per-target X/Y entities were found.

user.title: Add a room or spot
user.description: Creates an occupancy device for a room or a spot (a desk, a sofa). It starts as a 1 × 1 m square in front of the radar; draw its real shape in the Presence panel.

data_description.area_id: Leave empty to use the radar's area.

reconfigure.title: Room or spot
reconfigure.description: Shape and behaviour are edited in the Presence panel.

data_description.area_id: Leave empty to use the radar's area.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Rooms, spots, doorways and ignore areas are edited in the Presence panel in the sidebar.

data_description.reconnect_grace_s: Seconds to ignore a radar's detections after it comes back from unavailable. Ghost targets often appear right after a reconnect.
data_description.outside_doors: Doors, garage doors and locks to outside that no radar watches (a garage door: its area is counted at its doors). Doors on radar doorways are picked up from the doorways.
data_description.evidence: Switches, lights, buttons and door contacts (closets, inner doors) that mean someone is in their area when used. Only changes made by hand count: not by automations, scripts or the app. Used to count occupants, for rooms without a radar and for people who sit still.
data_description.evidence_on: Like the above, but only switching on counts: for things a timer or the device itself turns off (a fan on a timer).
data_description.occupancy: Sensors that stay on while someone is there, like a bed sensor. While any of them in a room is on, at least one person is there: they are not taken for someone seen elsewhere, and a door does not put them in doubt. A bed's two sides are one sign of at least one person, not one each.
data_description.vacuums: A robot vacuum moves like a person to a radar. While one is cleaning, the occupant count ignores the radars in the room it reports (its current room sensor, matched to an area by name).
